objective: Clear verification backlog, satisfy wave gates, then author Wave 5. Prioritize speed and quality.

policy.originalCheckout: Preserve pre-existing uncommitted drafts; do not edit original checkout.
policy.integration: Coordinator alone integrates commits, edits global ledgers and updates MASTER_PLAN.
policy.acceptance: Primary source comparison, independent calculations where applicable, native input and agent screenshot checks; retain all unsupported material claims as flags. Independent peer review before acceptance.
policy.outputs: Unique server ports or ephemeral listeners and worker-specific temporary evidence directories. Performance measurements run without competing browser jobs.
policy.wave5: Prepared only until verification gates pass; do not relabel pending work as complete.
